notes.title: Virtual Axe Throwing is Coming!
notes.notes:
Virtual Axe Throwing!

The world around your arcade is growing! Real world axe-throwing pioneers, BATL, have moved into the neighbourhood and are open for business! Thanks to the success of your arcade, the area around your venue is beginning to attract top entertainment brands.

Now it’s up to you to unleash your inner lumberjack! Grab some friends and venture out into the street to explore the neighbourhood where you'll find BATL Axe Throwing, the real-life axe throwing chain, and inventors of the sport! Select from a variety of axes, step up to the line and throw, savoring the resounding thud of steel embedding into the timber target.

Here's what's you can expect in axe throwing:

[list]
[*] Play solo or with up to 4 people in multiplayer.
[*] Standard axes available to use immediately.
[*] Ten incredibly weird and wonderful axes have been added to your prize store.
[*] Traditional axe throwing lanes and a super-sized axe throwing gallery.
[*] Get big discounts in-game to use at real-world BATL locations for axe throwing IRL!
[*] Enjoy a soundscape that any urban lumberjack is sure to love!
[/list]

Classic axe throwing games mixed with new arcadified formats:

[list]
[*] [b]Standard BATL[/b] – High score competition on official IATF Targets.
[*] [b]Classic Target[/b] – Smaller scoring rings with more point variations.
[*] [b]Tic-Tac-Toe[/b] – The classic head-to-head game puts accuracy to the test!
[*] [b]Bullseye Blitz[/b] – A giant bullseye that increases in value but shrinks in size with each hit!
[*] [b]Ultra BATL [/b]– Get ready... this target is larger-than-life!
[/list]

10 incredible axes to redeem with tickets in your prize store!

Laugh with friends, make some new ones, and compete for top scores and bragging rights! Let the axe-citement begin!

About BATL Axe Throwing

BATL founded the sport of urban axe throwing in 2006 as The Backyard Axe Throwing League, and are a proud founding member of the International Axe Throwing Federation (IATF), the sport's official governing body.  Now simply known as BATL Axe Throwing, they have 17 locations across the U.S. and Canada, with more coming in the future!  Want to go axe throwing IRL?  There might be a BATL location near you - check them out at [url=http://www.batlgrounds.com]www.batlgrounds.com[/url]

You can book a real axe throwing session using [b]BATLARCADE10[/b] at checkout for 10% off!  We'd love to see your adventures, make sure to use [b]#BATLVR[/b] when you share your photos and stories!

notes.title: The Ultimate Virtual Reality Arcade Levels Up
notes.notes:
[b]Arcade Legend adds its first officially licensed DLC to its [url=https://www.oculus.com/experiences/quest/4290234067753903/]Meta Quest version[/url], and the same content will be available when the game launches on Steam later this year![/b]

In Arcade Legend, players must restore an abandoned arcade and customize it using a wide variety of materials, furniture, and decorations.  Earning reputation by accomplishing tasks allows them to unlock attractions and games which they can arrange inside their venue.  Players also have access to their very own prize store where they can redeem a range of prizes with the tickets they win from playing games.  Players can visit their friends arcades or invite them into theirs, with more multiplayer options coming in future releases. 
 
The first expansion pack will feature Quik Drop, Sink It, and Big Bass Wheel, one of the most popular and successful redemption arcade games of the past decade. ArcadeXR has teased that the second DLC pack features arguably the most iconic game in arcade history, with the official announcement scheduled closer to release.  

[previewyoutube=MxKc12l9dAk;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Quik Drop[/b]
Put your hand eye coordination to the test in a race against the clock! Quik Drop is easy to learn, difficult to master, and is sure to keep you on the edge of your seat. Whether you're a seasoned arcade player or a first-timer, give Quik Drop a try and see why it's one of the most popular arcade games around.

[b]Sink It[/b]
The classic party game comes to the arcade!  Hone your skills for a big ticket win or go head-to-head for competitive play!  It's a fun and challenging game that's perfect for any age, no ID required!

[b]Big Bass Wheel[/b]
Big Bass Wheel is the REEL deal!  Land the big one with the most popular ticket redemption game of the last decade.  It has all the thrills of a gameshow, packed in the mouth of a big fish!

notes.title: Arcade Legend coming to Oculus Quest and Steam in 2022
notes.notes:
Australia/Singapore - October 19, 2021.  LAI Games has announced that their new consumer VR title, Arcade Legend, which is currently in development is set for a dual release on both Steam and the Oculus Quest Store in 2022.

Inside Arcade Legend, an arcade builder and gameplay simulator, you’ve inherited a mysterious old arcade which was once a legendary entertainment destination. Before you can open your doors for business, however, you’ll need to do some cleaning up.  Restore and customize your arcade using a wide range of materials, then fill it with officially licensed arcade games to earn revenue and build Reputation, which unlocks new attractions that you can play solo or with friends.  Casual, competitive, and always social, you can chill out with friends, go head-to-head on global leaderboards against the best players in the world, or open your doors to the public to show off what you’ve built.

“As arcade game developers, it’s our goal to deliver accessible, rewarding and unique games and experiences to players heading out for a good time with their friends and families.” says Shannon Perell, LAI’s Head of Product Development and Creative Director for Arcade Legend. “Arcades are such a special and unique social space, and we’re so excited to have the opportunity to bring an authentic arcade gaming experience to both Steam and Oculus Quest."

LAI Games has already secured a deal with two other well-known arcade game manufacturers to bring a number of their officially licensed games into Arcade Legend. In the future, this content will come as both free and paid DLC packs, and the company has plans to bring more officially licensed products to the game over time.

Players will have multiple opportunities to be part of exclusive beta testing periods before its dual launch on Steam/Oculus Quest.  Players can learn more about Arcade Legend at our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1490600/Arcade_Legend/]Steam store page.[/url]

notes.title: Why Play At An Arcade, When You Can Own One?
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40296823/21ff4ca32f1e280b10f774a0a06ef67b7f8df1ca.png[/img]

There is a popular saying about life being a great teacher, but unlike school, life gives you the test first and the lesson afterwards.

And there may not have been a more difficult test for the Out-of-Home Entertainment Industry than the COVID-19 pandemic. Some traditional arcade game manufacturers didn't make it out of the pandemic alive, but there were also some that found innovative ways to leverage COVID into new opportunities. One of those companies was LAI Games, a company who has been making real-world arcade games for over 60 years, and in 2020 they started on their first in-home consumer VR game built around their core competency: building great arcade games and experiences.

LAI Games plans to work with other arcade industry manufacturers to bring more officially licensed games to Arcade Legend, and they've already secured a deal with another prominent manufacturer to bring one of the most iconic arcade titles to the game in the next few months. 

Read the full story at: https://www.patreon.com/VRMagazine
Do subscribe to VR Trend Magazine if you want to read more about the latest VR news and updates!

notes.title: Updates and Changelog - June 15

[h1]Arcade Legend's Road to Next Fest 2021![/h1]

Things have been moving fast and furious inside the arcade over the last 2 months.  We ran a private closed beta test and got some incredible feedback before allowing some of our Discord community exclusive access to a build of our pre-Next Fest demo.  They gave us even more valuable feedback, and we've reworked entire systems within the arcade to deliver the best version of our game demo for Next Fest. Now we're ready to reveal Arcade Legend to the world!  [url=https://discord.gg/XnevCnq6dN]Join our growing Discord community[/url] to talk to other players, and tell us what you think of the game!

notes.title: Heroes meet the Legend
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40296823/933cb40972422f9073ed4b14aae0206ade2aa33c.png[/img]

Development on the game started around 8 months ago as a way for LAI Games to offer their own, professional take on the “virtual arcade” genre (i.e., an arcade-operation simulator). There are a few titles out there that do this – one I own is called Arcadecraft, and I’ve heard of others like Pierhead Arcade (which has a Speed of Light clone in it, along with knock-offs of other staples of the carnival & amusement scene). LAI for their part, is able to take it up a few notches by creating faithful virtual recreations of their own games including Stacker, Speed of Light, HYPERShoot, Let’s Bounce and more. For fans of these titles, it means you finally get to enjoy them in VR. 

Read the full story at: https://arcadeheroes.com/2021/04/29/coming-soon-to-steam-build-your-own-virtual-arcade-in-arcade-legend-by-lai-games/

---

notes.title: Build Your Own Retro VR Arcade In ‘Arcade Legend’
notes.notes:
[url=https://vrscout.com/news/build-retro-vr-arcade-in-arcade-legend/][img]https://l3apq3bncl82o596k2d1ydn1-wpengine.netdna-ssl.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/04/ArcadeLegend_2.jpg[/img][/url]

Arcade Legend is a game within a game. Here’s the scoop: you’ve just inherited a dilapidated arcade and its up to you to return what was once a world-class family entertainment destination to its former glory as the ultimate gaming haven.

To do that you’ll need to unravel a series of mysteries surrounding the old arcade. Each time you unlock a mystery, you are rewarded with a new feature that you can use to upgrade and customize your arcade. As you continue to improve your space, you’ll attract more customers and raise greater revenue which can be used to purchase official LAI Games titles.

As the owner, it’s up to you to rearrange and customize your arcade to fit new games while maintaining an aesthetically pleasing playspace. You can control the settings of each individual game and earn prizes that can be used to customize your avatars or the interior of your VR arcade. There’s even a global leaderboard, allowing you and your friends to compete against players around the world.

Read more: [url=https://vrscout.com/news/build-retro-vr-arcade-in-arcade-legend/]https://vrscout.com/news/build-retro-vr-arcade-in-arcade-legend/[/url]
